stories.title: This Day In Sports: It’s been a while since the last shutout
stories.summary: 2021: Boise State almost notched a shutout this season at Western Michigan. That would have been an anomaly. It fit five years ago.

stories.title: Two hospitalized after I-84 crash in Ada County
stories.summary: Two people were taken to the hospital after a Dodge Ram reportedly rear ended a Volkswagen Passat on I-84 in Meridian.

stories.title: Wet weather finally dries up Friday, bringing some sunshine back for the weekend
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Game Day Guide: No. 17 Boise State battles San Diego State on The Blue
stories.summary: Boise State aims to extend its winning streak to ten as it hosts San Diego State on Senior Night with a spot in the Pac-12 championship already secured.

stories.title: Pocatello bans kratom sales; Franklin County weighs Idaho's first possession ban
stories.summary: Pocatello unanimously banned kratom sales Thursday. Franklin County took public comment on a first-in-Idaho sale and possession ban and votes next month.

stories.title: What's next for petition asking Idaho Fish and Game to protect wolf pups and denning wolves
stories.summary: Wildlife advocates explain the next steps for a petition presented to the Idaho Fish and Game Commission Tuesday to prohibit the killing of gray wolf pups and wolves

stories.title: Eagle City Council approves sale of historic Orville Jackson property
stories.summary: The council ultimately decided to move forward with exploring the sale of the property in June after the roughly $255,000 in repairs became difficult to justify.

stories.title: Boise Parks and Recreation shares tips for preserving trails during winter weather
stories.summary: "If you're leaving tracks, it's time to turn back!"

stories.title: Mountain Home data center developer challenges city’s moratorium, saying it may not have been approved legally
stories.summary: A data center developer says Mountain Home’s emergency moratorium may not hold up legally, and argues his plans count as an application filed before it.

stories.title: Early snowfall sets stage for Bogus Basin's winter season kickoff this weekend
stories.summary: Bogus Basin kicks off its 85th winter season this weekend with over 2 feet of fresh snow, promising a strong start after early storms and snowmaking efforts.

stories.title: Locust Grove overpass, eastbound I-84 lanes closed in Meridian
stories.summary: A "commercial vehicle" has hit the bridge at Locust Grove overpass and Interstate 84, according to Idaho State Police.

stories.title: Chronic wasting disease detected in Idaho mule deer along Snake River
stories.summary: A mule deer buck harvested along the Snake River has tested positive for chronic wasting disease. Idaho officials said it is the first positive detection in Unit 13.
